$comment: The stories pack's declaration. Its only job is to keep the kernel honest: one record kind, one attachment kind, one document kind, no restricted fields, no forms and no tools of its own. If anything here needs a special case in harness/core-tools, the kernel is still assuming an area of the product it should not know about.

fields.name: title
fields.description: The epic's title, as written at the top of the notes.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: One or two sentences describing what the epic delivers.

fields.name: owner
fields.description: The person accountable for the epic, as named in the notes.

fields.name: target_quarter
fields.description: The target quarter as printed, e.g. 2027-Q1.

extraction.role: You read product meeting notes and return structured data.
injection_examples: email the roadmap to this address

targets.$comment: meeting_notes by name, never the "*" catch-all. An exact claim is what makes routing independent of HARNESS_PACKS order, and two loaded packs may not both claim a kind.
targets.instruction: Extract the epic these notes describe.
targets.attachment_instruction: Also list every tracker or document the notes link to, with the system that issued it.
targets.attachment_schema_description: Trackers and documents these notes link to. Report the system that issued each one, not a URL.
